info.title: My SmartHealth app API (Mediqzy)
info.description:
The contract the My SmartHealth mobile app and partners build against.

Authentication uses a bearer JWT from sign-in. Patient endpoints enforce ownership; provider and admin endpoints additionally enforce their roles and tenant scope. Refresh and revocation endpoints accept refresh credentials rather than a bearer token.

Error envelopes vary by endpoint; many carry `success: false` and `message`. Integration and SmartCRM errors add a stable `code` to branch on.

Scope: employee benefits and insurance, addresses, sign-in and session rotation, appointments, lab booking/cart/history, pharmacy and pharmacy orders, billing/payments, membership, and admin integration status.

post.summary: Redeem the one-time code from a Google/Facebook mobile sign-in for the tokens
post.description:
Mobile flow: open /api/auth/google (or /facebook) with mobile_redirect_uri=mysmarthealth://oauth-callback, your own random `state`, and code_challenge = BASE64URL(SHA256(code_verifier)) with code_challenge_method=S256.

The app is called back with `code` and your `state` (check it matches) — never a token. Post the code with the original code_verifier here within 60 seconds. A code works once; a wrong verifier consumes it.

400.description: Expired, already used, or the verifier does not match.

503.description: Hand-off storage unavailable; sign in again.

Safe to repeat.

post.summary: Price a lab booking before it is made
post.description: Send the POST /api/labs/book body (appointmentDate/appointmentTime optional). Returns the total POST /api/labs/book will charge for it; both use one pricing function: the lab’s own price list (or the Standard catalogue) less the booking user’s plan lab benefit. Creates nothing. A test the lab does not offer (or not bookable) is refused with 400 errorCode TEST_NOT_BOOKABLE and unavailableTests [{id, name}]. A family health-package booking whose package has no price or family discount configured is refused with 409 errorCode FAMILY_PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED.

post.summary: Book a lab appointment and linked patient history atomically
post.description: Server-priced by the same function as POST /api/labs/book/quote: each test at the lab’s own price (or the Standard catalogue) by its id (a client price is ignored), less the booking user’s plan lab benefit, and no other fee is added, so appointment.totalFee and payment.amount equal quote.totalFee for the same body. If a plan allowance was spent by another booking in between, nothing is booked and 409 errorCode QUOTE_CHANGED returns the new quote. A test the lab does not offer (or not bookable) is refused with 400 errorCode TEST_NOT_BOOKABLE and unavailableTests [{id, name}]. A family health-package booking whose package has no price or family discount configured is refused with 409 errorCode FAMILY_PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED. Use labTestId for /api/lab-tests/{id} and mobile Orders. appointment.id is a separate reference for /api/appointments operations. Billing metadata preserves both references.

post.summary: Paid but still locked: finish the plan payment
post.description: "Already have a plan? Check again". Asks Razorpay about the caller's own plan orders from the last 30 days and activates any that were paid but never activated (the app lost the checkout reply). Reachable while the account is locked. The membership gate does the same on the first gated request after sign-in. Reply: activated, pending and needsHelp counts, accountStatus, hasActivePlan, plan {id,name} and a message to show. 503 RECONCILE_UNAVAILABLE when Razorpay cannot be reached.

post.summary: Support: start a member's plan from a Razorpay payment id
post.description: Staff only (admin, super_admin, team). Verified against Razorpay exactly like the payment webhook: our server-priced plan order, captured, covering the order, not already used. 409 when not paid yet, 422 when a plan rule refuses it (needs a refund or a decision), 404 for an unknown payment.
